Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready 4-direction CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET with true transparent alpha, for isometric dungeon repair puzzle.
Exactly 2048x2048 image divided into 4x4 invisible uniform 512x512 cells, sixteen full-body sprites, one sprite per cell. NO drawn grid, text, labels, letters, numbers, checkerboard or background.
Character: ONE consistent tiny dungeon repair worker, endearing stout proportions, oversized teal hood, two small pointed ear bumps under hood, round brass goggles worn on forehead, small pale face with two dark eyes, short teal coat, brown leather apron, simple leather gloves and boots, small wrench on belt. NOT skeleton and NOT armored fighter. Identical design, proportions, colors, face and outfit in every frame. No separate tools floating around.
Art: hand-painted stylized 2.5D, crisp silhouette and chunky soft bevels, no outlines heavier than necessary, restrained texture, warm ivory face and bronze accents against desaturated teal. Light always upper left. Orthographic isometric game camera looking downward at 30 degrees, no perspective changes between frames. Character is about 300px tall; full body within each 512px cell, feet on consistent ground anchor x=256,y=416. Transparent margin all sides. No platform or background, no contact-shadow cloud.
Rows determine facing:
Row 1 worker faces NORTHEAST / back-right, showing back and right side, face mostly away.
Row 2 worker faces SOUTHEAST / front-right, showing face and right side.
Row 3 worker faces SOUTHWEST / front-left, showing face and left side.
Row 4 worker faces NORTHWEST / back-left, showing back and left side.
Columns determine pose:
Column 1: calm standing idle, both feet grounded, relaxed arms.
Column 2: walking key pose A, left foot forward, right foot behind, natural opposite arm swing.
Column 3: walking key pose B, right foot forward, left foot behind, opposite arm swing.
Column 4: carrying-ready standing pose, both gloved hands held forward around an EMPTY OPEN SPACE at chest height; do NOT draw carried item.
Maintain exactly sixteen correct figures, four facing directions, four poses each. Easy frame slicing, no overlap. True alpha transparency. No text, no watermark.
